data.name: Chitu
data.gender_notes: Chitu is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chitu is recorded with the meaning “Little One”. Chitu is a Hindu name meaning “Little One”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chitu expresses “Little One”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The name Chitu is recorded with the meaning “Little One”. Chitu is a Hindu name meaning “Little One”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chitu total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

in_sanskrit.name: चित्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: derived from the Sanskrit word चित्र (chitra), meaning picture or drawing

in_hindi.name: चितू
in_hindi.long_meaning: derived from the Sanskrit word चित्र (chitra), meaning picture or drawing, with the addition of the ू (u) suffix

in_tamil.name: சிது
in_tamil.long_meaning: derived from சிறப்பு (ciṭṭu) meaning small or little, or from சித்து (citṭu) meaning learned or wise

in_telugu.name: చిటు
in_telugu.long_meaning: derived from చిత్ర (chiṭṭu) meaning picture or drawing, or from చిద్దు (chiddu) meaning wise or knowledgeable

in_marathi.name: Chitu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is small or little

in_bengali.name: Chitu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Little One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chitu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is small or little
